snippet.title: Gutsy Grid Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gutsy Grid is an Action Deck-builder. Battle through enemy encounters with your trusty Gutsy Bit console. Collect abilities through Carts and Console Mods. Wield the power of the Gutsy-Bit to stop a sinister plot threatening two worlds and have the raddest summer vacation ever.

In development for Steam - Wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4597800/Gutsy_Grid/
